scenario: A disruption-prep item should be cleared only after the booking thread, support ticket, travel policy note, and airline follow-up establish the coverage basis, then the booking state and live flight state confirm the approved close step.
user_instruction: Please clear the disruption-prep item for booking TRV-325-FLT. Follow the desk trail and only complete the approved close step if the booking and coverage checks all line up.

travel_booking_threads.body_text: Booking thread: clear disruption-prep item TRV-CLOSE-325 only after travel support ticket trv_ticket_325, travel policy note TRV-POL-325, and airline follow-up message TRV-FUP-325 all agree on the approved close step.

travel_support_tickets.body_text: Travel support ticket trv_ticket_325: this disruption-prep item only clears if booking TRV-325-FLT remains active, flight ZX325 is still operating, and no active insurance policy already exists for this booking.

travel_policy_notes.body_text: Policy note TRV-POL-325: disruption-prep items may only use the approved close step for active bookings without an existing travel insurance policy.

travel_airline_followup_messages.body_text: Airline follow-up message TRV-FUP-325: once TRV-CLOSE-325 is confirmed against trv_ticket_325 and TRV-POL-325, clear the prep item by activating travel insurance for TRV-325-FLT.
